title: iOS Cave app: eliminate swipe-action failures and UI delays
design: Import packet for iOS swipe reliability workstream. Covers mutation retry gaps, bulk reminder action latency, host discovery timeout storms, swipe UX behavior, main-thread decode stutter, and server persistence gaps for message/thread swipes.
acceptance_criteria: Child beads cave-ioswipe.1-.6 exist with clear ownership and scoped acceptance criteria; import succeeds and beads are queryable via bd show.

title: Add idempotent retries and batching to CaveClient mutations
design: Extend CaveClient mutation retry policy for idempotent DELETE/PATCH task/reminder writes and keep failure reporting explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Transient network blips do not immediately revert swipe delete/done operations; retry behavior is bounded and tested.

title: Batch bulk reminder actions instead of sequential per-id calls
design: Replace sequential per-reminder network loops with bulk API or bounded concurrent fan-out and per-item result handling.
acceptance_criteria: Bulk done/dismiss/snooze operations complete in one round trip or bounded concurrency with per-item outcome visibility.

title: Fail-fast host discovery and cache the working base URL
design: Short-circuit probing after first success, cancel remaining probes, persist last-good URL, and reduce discovery-induced interaction stalls.
acceptance_criteria: Reachable hosts connect quickly; unreachable discovery does not block swipe actions behind multi-probe timeout storms.

title: Fix swipe UX: full-swipe semantics, pending-delete feedback, task cancellation
design: Align full-swipe behavior with iOS expectations, show pending-delete row feedback, and avoid out-of-order Task races with cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: Calendar/Reminders/Tasks swipe interactions provide immediate clear feedback and remain consistent during rapid gestures/navigation.

title: Move JSON decoding off the main actor and debounce list refetches
design: Decode large payloads off main actor and avoid redundant full-list refetches on frequent view re-appearances.
acceptance_criteria: No visible stutter for large payloads and reduced unnecessary network churn when reopening tabs/views.

title: Persist message delete and thread archive/pin to the server
design: Add server-backed delete/archive/pin flows for chat/thread swipe actions with optimistic UI and explicit rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Message delete and thread archive/pin survive refresh/restart and reflect across clients with clear failure signaling.
